extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.17.12 - BingeTV: trailers on Home. Turn on "Play trailers on Home" (Settings > Home page layout): when a title stays focused (3 to 10 seconds, your choice), its trailer plays at the top right. v0.17.11 - BingeTV: the profile picker starts on your profile and shows locked ones; the service starts at once after a profile switch. v0.17.10 - BingeTV's profile window: clearer menu labels; the focused profile's note shows. v0.17.9 - BingeTV: after switching profile, Home opens on its menu bar's Home button. v0.17.8 - BingeTV: the profile picker shows the profiles like "Who's watching?", each with its options in its context menu (picture, rename, delete, add a profile); Exit BingeTV is there too. Settings that change the menu bar (hide Music or Live TV) apply straight away. v0.17.7 - BingeTV profiles: a new profile's setup (its own MDBList key) is no longer cut short as the profile loads, and Live TV copied into it is turned on.
